scd_strategy_v1: Type 1 dimensions with unknown rows. Keep source IDs and load metadata. Prepare columns for Type 2 later where useful, but do not implement historical dimension versioning in v1.
power_bi_strategy: Use mart CSVs for first beginner dashboards. Keep dim/fact CSVs available for advanced model building and validation.
current_history_policy: Use currently available data only. The model is designed so future 24-month extracts can be loaded without changing the star schema.
